items.headline: DOE says it will not exercise further HALEU contract options with Centrus
items.what_happened: In its third-quarter 2026 results, released November 4, Centrus said the President's fiscal year 2027 budget request does not include further funding to operate the HALEU cascade under its HALEU Operation Contract, about $0.8 billion of its Technical Solutions backlog as of September 30, 2026, and that DOE does not currently intend to exercise further options under that contract. Neither is a termination notice.
items.why_it_matters: The HALEU Operation Contract pays for Centrus's Piketon cascade, which makes HALEU, the fuel most microreactor designs need. A buyer counting on DOE-supplied fuel should ask what supply backs its fuel schedule once the current contract options run out.
items.binding_note: A statement of DOE intent in an earnings release. No contract change has been executed.
